notes: Two axes for classifying what a report is about. The first follows the State of Natural Resources Report (SoNaRR): its eight broad ecosystems plus the three cross-cutting resources (air, soils, water). The second holds the hazard families every hazard in config/reference/hazards.json belongs to. Node ids are unique across both axes.

nodes.name: Marine
nodes.note: Welsh seas, about 32,000 square kilometres with 139 marine protected areas; seabed, water column, fisheries and blue carbon.

nodes.name: Coastal margins
nodes.note: Dunes, saltmarsh, shingle, cliffs and intertidal habitats, including coastal squeeze and managed realignment.

nodes.name: Freshwaters
nodes.note: Rivers, lakes, ponds and wetlands as ecosystems: water quality, habitat and freshwater species.

nodes.name: Mountains, moorlands and heaths
nodes.note: The uplands, including blanket bog and upland peat, heathland and montane habitats.

nodes.name: Semi-natural grasslands
nodes.note: Species-rich meadows, pastures and road verges managed at low intensity.

nodes.name: Enclosed farmland
nodes.note: Improved grassland, arable and the hedgerows between them: the largest land use in Wales.

nodes.name: Woodlands
nodes.note: Broadleaved, conifer and mixed woodland, including commercial forestry, woodland creation and tree health.

nodes.name: Urban
nodes.note: Towns and cities: green and blue infrastructure, urban trees and the built environment's natural resources.

nodes.name: Air
nodes.note: Air quality and atmospheric deposition, including ammonia and nitrogen deposition on habitats.

nodes.name: Soils
nodes.note: Soil health, soil carbon, erosion, compaction and contaminated land.

nodes.name: Water
nodes.note: Water as a resource: abstraction, supply, groundwater and water quantity.

nodes.name: Plant and tree disease
nodes.note: Pathogens and pests of trees, crops and wild plants.

nodes.name: Animal disease
nodes.note: Disease in wild animals, livestock and fish that bears on the environment.

nodes.name: Invasive species
nodes.note: Invasive non-native species on land, in freshwater and at sea.

nodes.name: Drought and water scarcity
nodes.note: Low rainfall, low river flows and pressure on water supply.

nodes.name: Flood and storm
nodes.note: River, surface water and coastal flooding, storms and their knock-on effects such as coal tip instability.

nodes.name: Wildfire
nodes.note: Vegetation fires on upland, heath, grassland and forest.

nodes.name: Pollution incident
nodes.note: Point and diffuse pollution of water, land and air, from single incidents to chronic loading.

nodes.name: Climate extreme
nodes.note: Heatwaves on land and at sea, extreme cold and other weather extremes not covered by flood, drought or fire.

nodes.name: Funding and capacity
nodes.note: Pressure on the budgets, staffing and delivery capacity of public bodies and partners.

nodes.name: Regulatory and legal change
nodes.note: New, changed or challenged law and regulation, including court cases and regulatory divergence.

nodes.name: Market and land use change
nodes.note: Shifts in farm economics, energy, forestry markets, insurance and land use.
